question_en: A three-phase motor shows increasing vibration and a current trend different from baseline. What evidence should guide the next maintenance decision?
options: Analysis of the measured current and vibration trends against baseline and specifications.
explanation_en: D-25 maintenance uses current and vibration results and requires comparison and analysis against references.
explanation_es: El mantenimiento D-25 usa resultados de corriente y vibración y exige comparación y análisis contra referencias.
